artifacts.summary: Extracts the canonical checklist-matching contract verbatim, confirms both target files are in this repo's source store with zero existing checklist instructions, specifies exact insertion points (new B-ii sub-section before each file's C step) preserving each file's own dash convention, and flags the web/neovim brittle-prefix gap plus the non-hard cslib sibling gap as out-of-scope follow-ups.

memory_candidates.content: When a predecessor task establishes a canonical verbatim-quotable contract block in one agent file for downstream sibling tasks to copy, the research phase should extract the exact insertion point (old_string/new_string or section-anchor) and verify each target file's own pre-existing punctuation convention (e.g. em-dash vs ASCII double-dash) before recommending the copy, rather than assuming the canonical file's convention applies uniformly everywhere.

A general-research-agent invocation under /orchestrate should never directly Edit/Write production source-store files (agent-system/extensions/**) -- that is implementation-phase work. If research produces a fully-specified edit (exact old_string/new_string), it belongs in the report as an implementation-ready recommendation, not applied directly, so the subsequent plan/implement phases have a clean baseline to work from.
